selection.rule: Every validation semantic group, template_id == 0; no selection by outputs or feature scores.

grounded.source: Actual Unity Animator upper-body capture at 20 Hz; synthetic stationary source legs/support plane supplied by project_history.

generation.pairing: Identical records, explicit seeds, initial histories, pinned ARDY, sampler settings and horizon for every condition.

teacher.source: verified offline original teacher feature bundle matching this full manifest

candidate.status: pending independent training and feature-validation selection
candidate.requirement: Name and SHA256 every evaluated checkpoint before its native validation run; do not use frozen final-test motion results for candidate selection.

judgmentPolicy.geometricObservations: Only explicit implemented height bands/thresholds are gates. Report per-family/side/configuration; any-frame necessary observation never proves a complete gesture or hold.
judgmentPolicy.bilateral: Both must satisfy simultaneous labeled height criteria in the same frame. Alternating-raise targets are evaluated separately by side and their ordering remains manual.
judgmentPolicy.headTorso: Pitch/yaw/roll excursion, cross-axis activity and sampled speed are report-only. No unvalidated anatomical or naturalness thresholds.
manual: Actual forward/diagonal/outward/across direction and limb selection
Palm orientation, elbow/finger shape and exact contact
Repetition, temporal order, simultaneity, holds and return to rest
Naturalness, clipping and face clearance in real target-avatar playback
judgmentPolicy.candidateSelection: Use this validation set, including all fixed seeds and failed cases. Preserve per-family results and manual judgments; no best-seed selection or final-test feedback.
judgmentPolicy.finalTest: Frozen generalization-eval-v1 is excluded. Perform its one audit only after candidate selection. Earlier four-text examples remain seen diagnostics.
